framework.name: Strategic Priority 1 - Democratic Governance, Rule of Law, and Human Rights
framework.description:
Democratic Governance, Rule of Law and Human Rights 
Outcome 1:   People in Tajikistan have their rights protected and benefit from improved access to justice and quality services delivered by accountable, transparent, and gender responsive legislative, executive and judicial institutions at all levels.

children.name: Outcome 1.1 - Democratic Governance, Rule of Law, and Human Rights
children.description: Outcome 1:   People in Tajikistan have their rights protected and benefit from improved access to justice and quality services delivered by accountable, transparent, and gender responsive legislative, executive and judicial institutions at all levels.

children.name: Output 1.1.1 - National and local policies, strategies, legal frameworks and systems are developed/updated based on sound evidence in a participatory and accountable manner in line with international legal instruments, SDGs and human rights standards

Output 1.1.2 - State institutions have the capacity to produce evidence, plan, budget and monitor in an inclusive, transparent and participatory manner to deliver quality public services, including digital services, with specific focus on most vulnerable including children at risk and their families, thus contributing to the SDG achievement in Tajikistan

Output 1.1.3 - Strengthened partnership and coordination between state and non-state actors to promote civic engagement for more inclusive public policy design, monitoring and reporting in  line with international standards and recommendations of the human rights bodies

framework.name: Strategic Priority 2 - Sustainable and equitable economic development
framework.description:
Sustainable and equitable economic development 
Outcome 2:   People in Tajikistan benefit from equitable and sustainable economic growth through decent and productive employment; stable energy supply; improved access to specialised knowledge and innovation and a more favourable business environment, especially for entrepreneurs and farmers.

children.name: Outcome 2.1 - Sustainable and Equitable Economic Development
children.description: Outcome 2:   People in Tajikistan benefit from equitable and sustainable economic growth through decent and productive employment; stable energy supply; improved access to specialised knowledge and innovation and a more favourable business environment, especially for entrepreneurs and farmers.

children.name: Output 2.1.1 - Enabling policy environment created for sustainable development  including greener economic recovery, investments in jobs, and pro-poor public spending to  accelerate SDG achievement
children.description: Enabling policy environment created for sustainable development  including greener economic recovery, investments in jobs, and pro-poor public spending to accelerate SDG achievement

children.name: Output 2.1.2 - Economic revitalization, jobs and livelihoods advanced through labour market development, improved business services , and ecosystems for digitalization
children.description: Economic revitalization, jobs and livelihoods advanced through labour market development, improved business services, and ecosystems for digitalization

children.name: Output 2.1.3 - Inclusive, sustainable and climate smart solutions adopted to improve access to and availability of natural resources (energy, land and water) for responsive production and sustainable economic growth

framework.name: Strategic Priority 3 - Social Development, Inclusion and Empowerment
framework.description:
Social Development, Inclusion and Empowerment 
Outcome 3:   People in Tajikistan benefit from quality, equitable and inclusive health, education and social protection systems. 
Outcome 4:   The nutritional status of the people in Tajikistan is improved through stable access to sufficient, appropriate and safe food; improved child feeding practices; better water and sanitation and improved access to quality health care.
Outcome 5:   Women, youth, children, people  with disabilities and other vulnerable groups are protected from violence and discrimination,  have  a voice that is heard and are respected as equal members of society.

children.name: Outcome 3.1 - Health, Education and Social Protection
children.description: Outcome 3:   People in Tajikistan benefit from quality, equitable and inclusive health, education and social protection systems.

children.name: Output 3.1.4 - Health Services Sustained, with special Emphasis on Vulnerable and At Risk Groups
Output 3.1.5 - Increased access to and completion of preschool and basic education including availability of alternative education and digital solutions
Output 3.1.6 - Healthy lifestyle, safety guidelines and supportive systems are mainstreamed in targeted schools to create an enabling environment  for learning.
Output 3.1.7 - Education system is strengthened to provide quality inclusive learning
Output 3.1.8 - National social protection system improved and relevant schemes put in place to ensure wider coverage of the vulnerable population
Output 3.1.1 - Emergency Coordination and Health Sector Governance enhanced
Output 3.1.2 - Integrated Surveillance system and laboratory capacities
Output 3.1.3 - Infection prevention and control (IPC) improved
Outcome 3.2 - Outcome 4: Nutrition and food security
children.description: Outcome 4:   The nutritional status of the people in Tajikistan is improved through stable access to sufficient, appropriate and safe food; improved child feeding practices; better water and sanitation and improved access to quality health care.

children.name: Output 3.2.1 - Food security and nutrition monitored and measures introduced to address food insecurity and malnutrition among the population including vulnerable households
Output 3.2.2 - Personal Safety Secured through improved sanitation at the household and workplace
Output 3.2.3 - Accelerated programs and mechanisms for the prevention and management of stunting and other forms of malnutrition in targeted areas are strengthened
Outcome 3.3 - Outcome 5: Inclusion and empowerment of vulnerable groups
children.description: Outcome 5:   Women, youth, children, people  with disabilities and other vulnerable groups are protected from violence and discrimination,  have  a voice that is heard and are respected as equal members of society.

children.name: Output 3.3.1 - Civil Society is enabled to engage in programmes and policy level discussions addressing violence, discrimination and emerging issues of inequality against vulnerable and marginalized groups
Output 3.3.2 - Prevention and response to violence and discrimination and protection of other vulnerable segments of the population strengthened
Output 3.3.3 - Exclusion and violent extremism addressed through participatory governance and socioeconomic opportunities for all

Output 3.3.4 - State partners have strengthened evidence-based knowledge to design/update legislations, policy frameworks, NAPs on Domestic Violence, GBV, SRH, violence and non-discrimination in line with international HR standards.
Output 3.3.5 - Youth and women are empowered to engage in decision-making and addressing the socioeconomic impact of COVID-19

framework.name: Strategic Priority 4 - Resilience and Environmental Sustainability
framework.description:
Resilience and Environmental Sustainability
Outcome 6:   People in Tajikistan are more resilient to natural and man-made disasters and benefit from improved policy and operational frameworks for environmental protection and management of natural resources.

children.name: Outcome 4.1 - Outcome 6 Resilience and Environmental Sustainability
children.description: Outcome 6:   People in Tajikistan are more resilient to natural and man-made disasters and benefit from improved policy and operational frameworks for environmental protection and management of natural resources.

children.name: Output 4.1.1 - Legislative, policy and institutional frameworks in place for disaster risk management and sustainable natural resource management, including climate change adaptation, biodiversity conversation, chemicals management that are in compliance with multilateral environmental agreements ratified by the Republic of Tajikistan
Output 4.1.2 - Strengthened institutional frameworks and capacities for disaster risk management and emergency preparedness, sustainable natural resource management and environmental protection
Output 4.1.3 - Better livelihoods through solutions for disaster risk management and emergency preparedness, sustainable natural resource management and environmental protection
